meta.pdf_title: Notice of Concealed Condition and Reservation of Rights - Corridor Ceiling

letter.re_text: Re: PCO-001. Notice of Concealed Condition and Reservation of Rights, corridor ceiling on the RTU-2 duct route. Sample Elementary School HVAC Replacement. Project 2026-0001.
body_paragraphs: Formal written notice under Contract Sections [A], [B], and [C]. This reserves our rights and serves as our Notice of Claim, sent by certified mail as Section [C] requires.

1. On March 3, 2026, we opened the corridor ceiling to run the new RTU-2 supply duct. We found abandoned piping and a beam not shown on the plans in the duct path. The duct cannot be installed as drawn.
2. We stopped work in that area and sent RFI-001 before disturbing the existing piping (Section [A]).
3. On March 9, 2026, the Engineer issued a revised duct route. We priced the added work in PCO-001, sent separately.
4. The revised route adds about five working days to the corridor work. We will confirm in writing if it moves the completion date.
5. We reserve a fair adjustment of the Contract Sum for this work (Section [A]), and added time to the extent the condition moves the completion date (Section [B]).
6. Please execute PCO-001 as a Change Order (Section [D]). We will proceed with the revised route on your written direction.
